wizard.title: Step-by-step Enrollment
wizard.lead: No login required. Enter your identity information and documents, complete authentication (Hoda), and receive a tracking code.

role.label: Application type
role.heading: Select application type
role.helpBody: "Student" is for academic admission and "Instructor / Faculty" is for educational collaboration. Other roles (parent, organization) are activated via support, and administrative roles (university/faculty president, content manager, support, etc.) are created by the university, not via public registration.

identity.label: Identity information
identity.heading: Identity information
identity.helpBody: All asterisks fields are required. The national ID is validated immediately. Please enter the birth date in the Solar Hijri format (e.g., 1380/05/12).

documents.label: Upload Documents
documents.heading: Upload Documents
documents.helpBody: Upload a clear image or scan of your documents. Allowed formats: JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF — each file must be under 1.3 MB. Asterisk-marked documents are required.

verification.label: Identity Verification
verification.heading: Identity Verification (Hoda System)
verification.helpBodyPart1: This inquiry is conducted based on your national ID, birth certificate number, and birth date, and has three levels: basic match, identity confirmation, and full inquiry.
verification.helpBodyPart2: Since direct access to the government system is not available, this step is
verification.helpBodyPart3: only, and the result will be attached to your file.
verification.helperText: If the verification level is low, you can return to the "Identity Information" step and complete the information. Submitting the application is possible at any level; final review is done by the admissions expert.

review.label: Review and Submit
review.heading: Review and Submit
review.helpBody: Please review your information once. To edit any section, return to the relevant step from the steps above. By clicking "Submit Application", your file will be registered and a tracking code will be issued.
